_comment: Template only -- copy to C:\ProgramData\SortView\config\agent_runtime_config.json and fill in real values before use. Never commit a copy of this file with real customer_id/branch_id/api_url filled in alongside a real token (the token itself never belongs in this file at all -- see SORTVIEW_API_TOKEN below). See docs/amh-production-cutover-runbook.md for the full cutover procedure this config is one part of.
_comment_bootstrap: bootstrap_mode 'normal' seeds each source at ITS CURRENT end-of-file the first time this state_path has no persisted entry for it -- no historical content is ever read. This is deliberate for cutover: do NOT set 'replay' here (see docs/amh-production-cutover-runbook.md's bootstrap analysis for why). This block only takes effect once, the very first time this state_path is used for each source -- irrelevant on every later restart.
_comment_shadow_mode: REMOVE upload_enabled/heartbeat_enabled entirely for a normal production run (the default, when omitted, is true/true = NORMAL PRODUCTION MODE). Keep both explicitly set to false ONLY while still validating this exact config file in shadow mode one more time before the real cutover.
_comment_token: SORTVIEW_API_TOKEN is READ FROM THE ENVIRONMENT ONLY -- it must never appear in this file. Set it as a Machine-scope environment variable via agent/deploy/set-sortview-api-token.ps1 before starting the agent.
